name: healthcare+
description: Healthcare+ - Advanced healthcare appointment system with microservices

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd services/auth-service && npm install && cd ../appointment-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../../shared && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd shared && npm run build && cd ../services/auth-service && npm run build && cd ../appointment-service && npm run build && cd ../notification-service && npm run build && cd ../../frontend && npm run build
scripts.dev:all: powershell -Command "$ports = @(3001, 3002, 3003); $missing = @(); foreach ($port in $ports) { if ((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Listen'}).Count -eq 0) { $missing += $port } }; if ($missing.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'All services already running - skipping startup' } else { Write-Host \"Starting services on missing ports: $($missing -join ', ')\"; npm run docker:up; npm exec concurrently -- \"npm run dev:auth\" \"npm run dev:appointment\" \"npm run dev:notification\" \"npm run dev:frontend\" }"
scripts.start:services: concurrently "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:appointment" "npm run start:notification"
scripts.start:all: npm run docker:up && npm run start:services && npm run start:frontend
scripts.db:init: cd services/auth-service && npm run db:init && cd ../appointment-service && npm run db:init && cd ../notification-service && npm run db:init
scripts.ports:list:all: powershell -Command "$ports = @(3001, 3002, 3003, 3010, 5432, 5433, 5434, 6379, 5672, 9092, 2181); foreach ($port in $ports) { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Property LocalPort, State, @{Name='ProcessName';Expression={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess).Name}} }"
scripts.ports:free:frontend: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3010 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Freed frontend port 3010'"
scripts.ports:free:auth: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Freed auth service port 3001'"
scripts.ports:free:appointment: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3002 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Freed appointment service port 3002'"
scripts.ports:free:notification: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3003 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Freed notification service port 3003'"
scripts.ports:free:db: powershell -Command "$ports = @(5432, 5433, 5434); foreach ($port in $ports) { Stop-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host \"Freed database port $port\" }"
scripts.ports:free:redis: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 6379 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Freed Redis port 6379'"
scripts.ports:free:kafka: powershell -Command "$ports = @(9092, 2181); foreach ($port in $ports) { Stop-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host \"Freed Kafka port $port\" }"
scripts.ports:free:rabbit: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5672 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Freed RabbitMQ port 5672'"
scripts.ports:free:services: npm run ports:free:auth && npm run ports:free:appointment && npm run ports:free:notification && npm run ports:free:frontend
scripts.ports:free:all: npm run ports:free:services && npm run ports:free:db && npm run ports:free:redis && npm run ports:free:kafka && npm run ports:free:rabbit
scripts.ports:list:db: powershell -Command "$ports = @(5432, 5433, 5434); foreach ($port in $ports) { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Property LocalPort, State, @{Name='ProcessName';Expression={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess).Name}} }"
scripts.ports:list:kafka: powershell -Command "$ports = @(9092, 2181); foreach ($port in $ports) { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Property LocalPort, State, @{Name='ProcessName';Expression={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess).Name}} }"
scripts.ports:check:auth: powershell -Command "if ((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Listen'}).Count -gt 0) { Write-Host 'Auth service is running'; exit 0 } else { Write-Host 'Auth service is NOT running'; exit 1 }"
scripts.ports:check:appointment: powershell -Command "if ((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3002 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Listen'}).Count -gt 0) { Write-Host 'Appointment service is running'; exit 0 } else { Write-Host 'Appointment service is NOT running'; exit 1 }"
scripts.ports:check:notification: powershell -Command "if ((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3003 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Listen'}).Count -gt 0) { Write-Host 'Notification service is running'; exit 0 } else { Write-Host 'Notification service is NOT running'; exit 1 }"
scripts.ports:check:frontend: powershell -Command "if ((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3010 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Listen'}).Count -gt 0) { Write-Host 'Frontend is running'; exit 0 } else { Write-Host 'Frontend is NOT running'; exit 1 }"
scripts.ports:check:services: powershell -Command "$ports = @(3001, 3002, 3003); $missing = @(); foreach ($port in $ports) { if ((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Listen'}).Count -eq 0) { $missing += $port } }; if ($missing.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'All services are running'; exit 0 } else { Write-Host \"Services NOT running on ports: $($missing -join ', ')\"; exit 1 }"
scripts.dev:services:smart: powershell -Command "$ports = @(3001, 3002, 3003); $missing = @(); foreach ($port in $ports) { if ((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Listen'}).Count -eq 0) { $missing += $port } }; if ($missing.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'All services already running - skipping startup' } else { Write-Host \"Starting services on missing ports: $($missing -join ', ')\"; npm run dev:all }"
scripts.dev:all:smart: powershell -Command "$ports = @(3001, 3002, 3003, 3010); $running = 0; foreach ($port in $ports) { if ((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Listen'}).Count -gt 0) { Write-Host \"Port $port is already running\" } else { $running = 1 } }; if ($running -eq 1) { npm run dev:all } else { Write-Host 'All services already running - skipping startup' }"
